info.title: AI Planner Pilot API
info.description: Proposed interface, not deployed. Paths assume tenant identity derived from authentication and brand membership verified on every tenant-scoped request. Existing application endpoints remain implementation inputs. Model routing, cost evidence and publication acceptance are independent contracts.
